editorNote: A day of single-name moves: Rocket Lab is lower after pushing Neutron's debut into 2027, Duolingo is under pressure on slower-growth worries, and Alibaba's insiders are in the news for buying. Gold and bitcoin both trade cautiously around inflation data. Headlines only; nothing here is investment advice.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab pushes Neutron's debut flight to 2027, and shares fall
stories.summary: Reuters reports Rocket Lab has moved the first flight of its Neutron rocket into 2027. Yahoo Finance puts the share slide at 15%, and Trefis describes a six-day losing streak that has the stock down 21%.
stories.whyItMatters: The delay pushes Rocket Lab's medium-lift debut back again; the share-price figures come from secondary outlets and differ by outlet.

Rocket Lab Shares Slide 15% as Neutron Rocket Launch Delayed Until 2027 - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Duolingo heads for its worst day in months as the CEO flags slower growth
stories.summary: Stocktwits reports Duolingo shares were heading for their worst day in months after its CEO flagged slower growth, and links part of the slide to T-Mobile's AI translation feature. Retail investors quoted in the piece call the selloff 'stupid'.
stories.whyItMatters: The stock is reacting to a growth warning and to AI-translation competition; the causal link is the outlet's framing, not a company statement.

sourceLinks.title: Duolingo Stock Heads For Worst Day In Months As CEO Flags Slower Growth — Retail Calls Selloff ‘Stupid’ - Stocktwits
DUOL Stock Tumbles On T-Mobile's AI Translation Feature — Retail Calls Selloff ‘Stupid’ - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Jack Ma reportedly buys $77 million of Alibaba shares after a $10.2 billion share sale
stories.summary: Stocktwits reports Jack Ma has bought about $77 million of Alibaba stock, following the company's $10.2 billion share sale. Separate coverage says Chairman Joe Tsai and CEO Eddie Wu also bought shares in an exchange filing.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider purchases came right after a discounted placement meant to fund AI spending; the amounts are as reported, not independently confirmed here.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Insider Buying Grows: Jack Ma Reportedly Bets $77M After $10.2B Share Sale - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Gold opens at its lowest of the week ahead of PPI data
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's October 15 gold report says prices opened at the lowest level of the week ahead of producer-price data. FXEmpire says gold rebounded as a softer dollar followed a hot CPI print, and FXStreet links a bounce to a report of Chinese Treasury buying pushing US yields lower.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold is trading off dollar and yield moves around the inflation data; the outlets differ on the day's driver.

stories.headline: Bitcoin stays boxed between $80,000 and $88,000
stories.summary: Benzinga says bitcoin is stuck between $80,000 and $88,000 and asks which level breaks first. Yahoo Finance's roundup says crypto prices are falling into a familiar pattern on October 15.
stories.whyItMatters: Price is still range-bound; no breakout in either direction has been reported.

stories.headline: A bitcoin mining pool that handled 2.3% of the network shuts after its hashrate falls 65%
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports that a bitcoin mining pool which once handled 2.3% of the network has shut down after its hashrate fell 65%.
stories.whyItMatters: Mining is consolidating around fewer pools; the headline is the only detail drawn from the report here.
